metadata.vintage: Confirmed from CHFA's official Dates and Deadlines page (chfainfo.com/rental-housing/housing-credit/dates-and-deadlines) on 2026-06-03; 2027 dates, QAP hearings and comment deadline re-verified 2026-09-24 against CHFA's QAP page (chfainfo.com/rental-housing/housing-credit/qualified-allocation-plan), its hearing notice (chfainfo.com/rental-housing/housing-credit/qap-hearing), the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft (section 3.B.2) and Third Draft Summary of Changes dated 2026-09-11, and the August 26, 2026 hearing presentation. CHFA's published cycle: R1 = 9% + State Credit (Feb deadline); R2 = 4% + State Credit (Aug deadline). Pure 4% deals are rolling; R2 specifically targets 4%-with-State-Credit projects. MIHTC has its own annual deadline.
notes: Round 1 = 9% LIHTC + State Credit (highly competitive; February application)
Round 2 = 4% LIHTC + State Credit (4% paired with State Credit; August application). Pure 4% / PAB is rolling outside this cycle.
MIHTC (Middle Income Housing Tax Credit) is annual with its own LOI/app cycle (March/May)
Every CHFA round requires a Letter of Intent (LOI) 60+ days before the application — LOI deadlines are the real first gate
Prop 123 awards run through DOLA on a separate cycle — see cdola.colorado.gov/proposition-123

The QAP covers two years (2027-2028) and is the plan that sets cycle dates, credit maximums and scoring; it is drafted January-June, taken to public hearings and written comment in July-August, then goes to the CHFA Board and the Governor in September-October (CHFA's own timeline, August 26, 2026 hearing presentation).

2027 and 2028 round dates come from the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft, which is not yet adopted. They are CHFA's published dates, so they are marked exact, but they can change until the Board and Governor approve the plan.

status is a snapshot as of metadata.generated. js/components/qap-calendar.js also compares each event's date (or date_end, when present) with today, so an event whose date has passed renders as past even if this field has not been refreshed.

events.name: 2026 R1 (9% + State) — Letter of Intent due
events.details: LOI was required 60+ days before R1 application.

events.name: 2026 R1 9% LIHTC + State Credit — application deadline
events.details: R1 applications were due Feb 2, 2026 by 5pm MT. 14 developments totaling 634 units / $219M allocated.

events.name: 2026 R1 9% LIHTC — awards announced
events.details: R1 reservation announcements; 2026 R1 awards bridge file in data/affordable-housing/chfa-awards/2026-round-one.json until live ArcGIS catches up.

events.name: 2026 MIHTC — Letter of Intent due
events.details: LOI for state Middle Income Housing Tax Credit was due March 16, 2026 by 5pm MT.

events.name: 2026 MIHTC — application deadline
events.details: Middle Income Housing Tax Credit applications were due May 18, 2026 by 5pm MT.

events.name: 2026 R2 (4% + State) — Letter of Intent due
events.details: LOI for R2 (4% LIHTC paired with State Credit) was due June 1, 2026 by 5pm MT — the required gate 60+ days before the August application.

events.name: 2026 R2 4% LIHTC + State Credit — application deadline
events.details: R2 applications were due August 3, 2026 by 5pm MT. R2 is the bond-driven 4% LIHTC paired with the Colorado State Credit (not 9% — that's R1). Pure 4% PAB-only deals stay on a rolling cycle outside this round.

events.name: 2026 R2 4% LIHTC + State Credit — awards announced
events.details: R2 reservations typically announced mid-December. Bridge file pattern in data/affordable-housing/chfa-awards/ will be used until live ArcGIS catches up.

events.name: 2027-28 QAP draft — first public hearing (Zoom)
events.details: First of three CHFA public hearings on the draft 2027-2028 Housing Tax Credit QAP, Tuesday July 14, 2026 at 11:00am via Zoom. The QAP now covers two years, 2027 and 2028.

events.name: 2027-28 QAP draft — second public hearing (Zoom)
events.details: Second public hearing on the draft 2027-2028 QAP, Thursday July 16, 2026 at 1:00pm via Zoom.

events.name: 2027-28 QAP draft — written comments due
events.details: CHFA accepted written comments on the draft 2027-2028 QAP up to August 14, 2026. Among the proposed changes: a Pilot Coordinated Funding and Concurrent Awards section that pairs competitive 2027 and 2028 tax-credit awards with state gap funding from the Division of Housing (DOH) and OEDIT.

events.name: 2027-28 QAP draft — third public hearing (Zoom)
events.details: Third public hearing on the draft 2027-2028 QAP, Wednesday August 26, 2026 at 10:00am via Zoom. CHFA then posted a Third Draft and Summary of Changes dated September 11, 2026.

events.name: 2027-28 QAP — CHFA Board approval, then Governor approval
events.details: CHFA's timeline (August 26, 2026 hearing presentation) puts the final draft before the CHFA Board, then the Board-approved plan before the Governor, in September-October 2026. CHFA has not published a specific date. For comparison, the 2025-26 QAP Second Amendment was adopted by the Board on September 26, 2025 and approved by the Governor on November 13, 2025.

events.name: 2027 R1 (9% + State) — Letter of Intent due
events.details: December 1, 2026 by 5pm MT, per section 3.B.2 of the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft (not yet adopted). LOI is the operative gate — without it on file, you cannot submit the R1 application. CHFA's Dates and Deadlines page still lists 2026 dates only.

events.name: 2027 R1 9% LIHTC + State Credit — application deadline
events.details: February 1, 2027 by 5pm MT, per section 3.B.2 of the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft (not yet adopted). R1 = 9% + State Credit. LOI prerequisite is due Dec 1, 2026 — see the LOI event. 2027 is the first round of the proposed DOH/OEDIT coordinated gap-funding pilot.

events.name: 2027 R1 9% LIHTC — awards announced
events.details: R1 reservation announcements typically late May.

events.name: 2027 R2 (4% + State) — Letter of Intent due
events.details: June 1, 2027 by 5pm MT, per section 3.B.2 of the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft (not yet adopted).

events.name: 2027 R2 4% LIHTC + State Credit — application deadline
events.details: August 2, 2027 by 5pm MT, per section 3.B.2 of the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft (not yet adopted). R2 pairs federal 4% credit with accelerated State Credit.

events.details: February 1, 2028 by 5pm MT, per section 3.B.2 (p. 16) of the 2027-28 QAP Third Draft (not yet adopted).

rolling_programs.name: 4% LIHTC + PAB (Private Activity Bond)
rolling_programs.description: 4% Tax-Exempt Bond financing is reviewed on a rolling basis: preliminary applications are accepted all year except February, August and December (2027-28 QAP Third Draft, section 3.B.2, p. 16). Limited by annual PAB allocation — see data/pab-allocations.json for current year's available cap.

rolling_programs.name: MIHTC (Middle Income Housing Tax Credit)
rolling_programs.description: State-only Middle Income tax credit serving 80-120% AMI. Annual cycle typically R1-aligned. Small allocation; competitive.

rolling_programs.name: Colorado State LIHTC
rolling_programs.description: State tax credit MUST be paired with federal 9% or 4%. Same cycles as federal. Roughly doubles equity yield on stacked deals. Transit Zone (TZ) credit (HB26-1065) may be awarded in lieu of standard state credit under a separate TZ Credit Allocation Plan, within the same fixed state-credit amounts (2027-28 QAP Third Draft, pp. 17, 31-32).

rolling_programs.name: Proposition 123 — Affordable Housing Fund
rolling_programs.description: Colorado statutory affordable-housing fund administered by DOLA. Separate cycle from CHFA — see cdola.colorado.gov/proposition-123 for current rounds.
